name: Haramase Meshimase
source:
Igusa Hideaki and Kouenji Sara are lovers, engaged to be married in the future. Their families have been feuding for generations and are therefore vehemently opposed to their relationship. In a moment of anger, Hideaki proclaims:

"Sara is pregnant with my child!"

That's a lie bound to make their families approve of the marriage. Not only is Sara not pregnant, she's still a virgin! To make it a reality, they begin the babymaking process. However, Nakano Shinobu, the assassin Sara's parents employ, keeps trying to cockblock Hideaki.

Will this lie ever change into truth?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ025367.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
井草秀明和高圆寺沙罗是一对恋人，他们即将结婚。他们的家族世代不和，因此强烈反对他们的关系。秀明一怒之下宣称：

“莎拉怀了我的孩子！”

这是一个谎言，注定会让他们的家人批准这桩婚事。萨拉不仅没有怀孕，而且还是处女！为了使其成为现实，他们开始了婴儿制作过程。然而，莎拉父母雇用的刺客中野忍一直试图阻止秀明。

这个谎言会变成真相吗？！

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ025367.html]DLsite[/url]]
